title: renderReadinessPO composes the register-ordered tables
description: Composes the two command-page tables into the readiness panel. The register controls paint order (engineer: blocking first; productOwner or null: questions first), both tables carry every blocker id (AC-18003-8, AC-18002-3). Fold readiness.questionOptional into the questions-table synthetic rows via the question-adapter so open decisions reach a row even when readiness.questions is empty.
